name: Moonwell grants allies 25% more healing and 100% more mana regeneration (#3720)
contract: Moonwell 804739 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, cooldown 120000, cast time index 5, duration index 8 = 15 s) has effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_PERSISTENT_AREA_AURA (27) with aura SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT (118), EffectBasePoints 24 resolving to 25, and effect 2 PERSISTENT_AREA_AURA with aura SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_REGEN_PERCENT (110), misc 0 (mana), EffectBasePoints 99 resolving to 100. Effect 1 is a plain SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY with no aura and no script, so it delivers nothing and promises nothing. Both area effects target DEST_DEST plus UNIT_DEST_AREA_ALLY (radius index 13 / 45). The tooltip reads 'All allied players standing within the well receive $s1% more healing, and their mana regeneration is increased by $s3%.' Native consumers, all stock: Unit::SpellHealingBonusTaken reads GetMaxPositiveAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT), and Player::UpdateManaRegen (StatSystem.cpp) multiplies the spirit-based regeneration by GetTotalAuraMultiplierByMiscValue(SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_REGEN_PERCENT, POWER_MANA). No module code or SQL references 804739 (only the stock-coefficient suppression list). The existing starcaller-ground-molten-core scenario proves the zone and the aura exist; this one pins the two amounts the consumers read to the tooltip's 25 and 100. COVERAGE LIMIT: the harness has no healing-taken or mana-regeneration metric, so the two stock consumers are quoted from code and not measured; the assertions stop at the resolved aura amounts. Fixture position and destination are copied from the ground-molten-core scenario, which is known to accept the cast.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Cast Moonwell on the caster's own position
The caster standing in the well receives its aura
The zone lasts at most its 15 second duration
